2.1 Multiple Choice Questions - 6 marks
This part consists of multiple choice sub-questions. Each sub-question has only ONE correct answer.
Select the single best answer for each. Each question is worth 2 marks.
MCQ (i): Which of the following statements about the convergence of Dynamic Programming
algorithms is FALSE?
(A) Policy Iteration converges in a finite number of iterations for finite MDPs
(B) Value Iteration converges to V
∗
in the limit as the number of iterations approaches infinity
(C) Policy Evaluation converges to V
π
in the limit for any fixed policy π
(D) Value Iteration is guaranteed to find the optimal policy in fewer iterations than Policy Iteration
(E) Both Policy Iteration and Value Iteration require knowledge of the MDP model (transitions
and rewards)
MCQ (ii): In Policy Iteration, what is the purpose of the policy improvement step?
(A) To compute the value function for the current policy
(B) To make the policy greedy with respect to the current value function
(C) To initialize the value function to zero
(D) To add exploration to the policy
(E) To compute the optimal value function directly
MCQ (iii): In Value Iteration, when does the algorithm stop updating the value function in
practice?
(A) When the policy becomes deterministic
(B) When the maximum change in value across all states falls below a threshold θ
(C) After a fixed number of iterations
(D) When all state values become positive
(E) When the greedy policy no longer changes
